_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Quests for zone 'sulphur_bight' on Vharlen, the Burning Isle. Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/vharlen-province.json).

mother_sarrai.name: Mother Sarrai
mother_sarrai.greeting: Yellowpan: we dig the yellow, we sell the yellow, we cough the yellow. Welcome.

pit_boss_drask.name: Pit-boss Drask
pit_boss_drask.greeting: Everything here is for sale. Especially if you are asking about something I should not have sold.

ilko_rhovek.name: Ilko Rhovek
ilko_rhovek.greeting: I guard the Pit Gate. Mostly from people trying to get out of the pits, not in.

angler_yellowpan.name: Tekk Sulvenn
angler_yellowpan.greeting: Do not drink from the yellow pools. Do fish them. Rinse after. See the ripples, just north of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

carter_yellowpan.name: Yssa Jakkora
carter_yellowpan.greeting: I do not go fast, I do not go near vents, and I do not stop for raiders. Fares are on the board.

quests.name: Sold by the Sack
quests.offer: Port Vharl sent you? Fine. Yes, I sold the Slagborn sulphur. They paid in gold and promised not to burn the pan. Then they stopped paying and started taking. Get my sacks back from the old workings and I will tell you where the rest went.

steps.text: Kill 6 Slagborn raiders in the old workings
Bring the sacks back to Pit-boss Drask in Yellowpan

quests.done: Half of them are empty. They are not selling it, they are pouring it out somewhere. The stilt folk at Stiltreach say the fen vents stink worse than ever. Start there.

quests.name: Spitting Season
quests.offer: The toads on the flats spit, and their spit eats boot leather. Half of Yellowpan is walking barefoot on hot ground. Do something.

steps.text: Kill 8 sulphur toads on the yellow flats

quests.done: The cobbler is crying. He was doing very well this month.

quests.name: The Crust King
quests.offer: Out on the crust fields the pumice golems have started walking in a line behind one big one. We call him the Crust King. He has not been crowned by anybody. He crowned himself.

steps.where: the crust fields by the shore
steps.text: Kill 4 pumice golems on the crust fields

steps.where: the crust fields by the shore

quests.done: The King is gravel. Long live nobody.

quests.name: The Assayer
quests.offer: Something down the spoil heaps catches miners and weighs them. Holds them up, turns them over, puts them down again. The ones it finds too light, it keeps. They call it the Assayer.

steps.where: the spoil heaps of Sulphur Bight

quests.done: Nobody is getting weighed today. Except at my counter, for sulphur.

quests.name: The Yellow Pits
quests.offer: The deep pits were shut when the air down there started catching fire on its own. Now there are lights moving in them again. Take a party, take a wet cloth for your face, and find out whose lights.

steps.text: Go down into the Yellow Pits
steps.where: The Yellow Pits, the dungeon door in Sulphur Bight

steps.text: Defeat whatever keeps the lights burning at the bottom of the pits
steps.where: the bottom of The Yellow Pits

quests.done: Shut again, and this time we are bricking it. You can keep the cloth.

quests.name: Old Yellowback
quests.offer: Every so often the flats heave and Old Yellowback climbs out of the biggest acid pool, older than the town and twice as wide. When the pan bell rings, grab a weapon. Everyone does.

steps.where: the acid pools of Sulphur Bight, when the pan bell rings (zone event)
steps.text: Defeat Old Yellowback when it rises

quests.done: Back in the pool he goes. He always comes back. So do we.
